pairs.registryProposal: portable-provider-package tells the package to walk requested, then preferred, then the first ready engine and to show the fallback. on-device-vs-cloud says a local-to-cloud step for transcription needs a consent ask and must not be fallback logic alone. A package that does the first by default breaks the second. The standard should say which rule wins when the allowed set contains both.
